Vitarkabādhane pratipakṣabhāvanam /II.33/
Vitarka-bādhane pratipakṣa-bhāvanam /II.33/

 « Si de mauvaises pensées viennent entraver [ces restreintes et ces astreintes], il faut
cultiver celles qui leur sont opposées. »

Eteṣāṃ yama-niyamānām / Vitarka-bādhane pratipakṣa-bhāvanam / Yadā–asya
brāhmaṇasya hiṃsā-ādayo vitarkā jāyeran haniṣyāmy aham apakāriṇam, anṛtam api
vakṣyāmi, dravyam apy asya svī-kariṣyāmi, dāreṣu ca–asya vyavāyī bhaviṣyāmi, parigraheṣu
ca–asya svāmī bhaviṣyāmi–iti / Evam unmārga-pravaṇa-vitarka-jvareṇa–atidīptena
bādhyamānas tat-pratipakṣān bhāvayet / Ghoreṣu saṃsāra-aṅgāreṣu pacyamānena mayā
śaraṇam upāgataḥ sarva-bhūta-abhaya-pradānena yoga-dharmaḥ / Sa khalv ahaṃ tyaktvā
vitarkān pun
